title: The Mughals Laying of Seige Around (Banda Singh)

blocks.text: The catalogue of loss continues until the siege itself becomes the main reality, and Baj Singh speaks sharply about what has been allowed to happen.
In his rebuke, the page turns from abstract decline to concrete criticism within the camp, showing that trust has thinned and blame is now being spoken aloud.
Baj Singh is the key anchor because he gives disciplined internal voice to what many must already be thinking.
